questions.answer: 12.05 per cent.

questions.question: What was the fuel cost adjustment charge for each kWh of electricity in April 2011?
questions.answer: KSh 6.15 for each kWh, up from KSh 5.73 in March 2011.
questions.evidence: p.2: "fuel cost adjustment charges rose from KSh 5.73 in March 2011 to KSh 6.15 in April 2011"

questions.answer: Ksh 37.30, down from Ksh 43.30 in July 2007.
questions.evidence: p.1: "tomatoes was selling at an average price of Ksh 37.30 in August 2007 compared with Ksh 43.30 in July 2007"

questions.question: Which base period does the Consumer Price Index of the August 2007 release use?
questions.answer: October 1997 = 100.
questions.evidence: p.2: "Base period: October 1997=100"

questions.question: In how many data collection zones were the retail prices for the Consumer Price Index of October 2023 collected?
questions.answer: 50 data collection zones.
questions.evidence: p.1: "50 data collection zones across the country"

questions.question: What was the national average retail price of one litre of petrol in October 2023?
By how much did the producer price of a tonne of sugar change between March 2017 and March 2018?

questions.evidence: p.1: "increase was on manufacture of wood and of products of wood which rose by 21.25 per cent"

questions.evidence: p.3: "Dense Bitumen Macadam (DBM) 7.76"

questions.question: What was the value of the exports of Kenya in January to March 2024?
questions.answer: KSh 296.6 billion.

questions.question: How many container vessels were handled in January to March 2024?
questions.answer: 232 container vessels, an increase of 17.8 per cent from the same quarter of 2023.
questions.evidence: p.4: "232 Number of container vessels handled in the period"; p.4: "17.8% increase from the same quarter in 2023"

questions.question: What was the unemployment rate in Kenya in the first quarter of 2019?
questions.answer: 6.2 per cent, with the strict definition of unemployment.
questions.evidence: p.7: "the survey results give a 6.2 per cent unemployment rate using the strict definition of unemployment"

questions.question: According to the Quarterly Labour Force Report of the first quarter of 2019, how many clusters and households does the sample of the Kenya Continuous Household Survey Programme have?
questions.answer: 1,684 clusters and 25,260 households.
questions.evidence: p.10: "The KCHSP sample consists of 1,684 clusters and 25,260 households"

questions.question: By how much did the economy of Kenya expand in the second quarter of 2008?
questions.answer: 3.2 per cent, compared to 8.9 per cent in the same quarter of 2007.
questions.evidence: p.2: "expanded by 3.2 per cent compared to a growth of 8.9 per cent in the same quarter of 2007"

questions.question: How much did the Electricity and Water sector grow in the second quarter of 2008?
questions.answer: 4.8 per cent, compared to 11.9 per cent in the same period of 2007.
questions.evidence: p.4: "The sector recorded a growth of 4.8 per cent in the second quarter of 2008 compared to a growth of 11.9 per cent"

questions.question: What share of the gross value added of Kenya did Nairobi contribute on average in 2013 to 2020?
questions.answer: 27.5 percent.
questions.evidence: p.13: "Nairobi contributed 27.5 percent of total"; p.22: "NAIROBI 27.5 27.5 27.6 27.6 27.5 27.7 27.6 27.0 27.5"; p.23: "Nairobi (27.5 percent)"

questions.question: What was the rate of the 91-day Treasury bill in May 2008?
questions.answer: 7.76 per cent, up from 7.35 per cent in April 2008.
questions.evidence: p.5: "from 7.35 per cent in April 2008 to stand at 7.76 per cent in May 2008"

questions.question: How many visitors arrived through Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and Moi International Airport in April 2008?
questions.answer: 42,749 visitors, down from 45,876 in March 2008.
questions.evidence: p.8: "from 45,876 visitors in March 2008 to 42,749 visitors in April 2008"; p.42: "April 40,686 2,063 42,749"

questions.question: How many county assembly wards does West Pokot County have?
questions.answer: 20 wards in 4 constituencies: Kapenguria 6, Kacheliba 6, Pokot South 4 and Sigor 4.
questions.evidence: p.18: "Kapenguria 6 Kacheliba 6 Pokot South 4 Sigor 4 Total 20"

questions.question: How many hospital beds did the four sub-counties of West Pokot County have in total in 2014?
questions.answer: 461 beds.
questions.evidence: p.51: "Pokot North 85 1 Total 461 5"

questions.question: What was the overall poverty rate in Kenya in 2019?
questions.answer: 33.6 per cent, which is 15.8 million people below the absolute poverty line.
questions.evidence: p.15: "The overall poverty rate in 2019 was 33.6 per cent, implying that 15.8 million people lived"; p.38: "was 33.6 per cent in 2019, which translates to 15.8 million individuals"

questions.question: What are the overall poverty lines for rural and urban areas in the poverty report of 2019?
questions.answer: KSh 3,252 in rural areas and KSh 5,995 in urban areas, for each adult equivalent in a month.
questions.evidence: p.32: "in monthly adult equivalent terms were computed as KSh 3,252 and KSh 5,995, respectively"

questions.question: Which age group had the highest unemployment rate in the first quarter of 2019, and did the same group have the highest long-term unemployment rate?
questions.answer: The age group 20-24, with an unemployment rate of 16.8 per cent. Yes: the same group had the highest long-term unemployment rate, 8.8 per cent.
questions.evidence: p.7: "The youth aged 20-24 had the highest unemployment rate of 16.8 per cent"; p.7: "had the highest proportion of the long-term unemployed at 8.8 per cent"; p.8: "20-24 207,321 2,346,459 8.8"

questions.question: What share of the unemployed persons in the first quarter of 2019 were long-term unemployed?
questions.answer: About 53 per cent: 577,549 long-term unemployed persons of 1,091,495 unemployed persons.

questions.question: In April 2011, did the transport index rise faster than the overall Consumer Price Index in the month, and what caused its rise?
questions.answer: Yes. The transport index rose by 4.29 per cent and the overall index by 3.20 per cent. The cause was the increased costs of petrol, diesel and bus/matatu fares.
questions.evidence: p.1: "the CPI increased by 3.20 per cent"; p.2: "The Transport index rose by 4.29 per cent, mainly due to increased costs of petrol, diesel and bus/matatu fares"

questions.question: The October 2023 release names three divisions that together account for over 57 per cent of the weights. Which of the three has the largest weight?
questions.answer: Food and Non-Alcoholic Beverages, with a weight of 32.9094 per cent. Housing, Water, Electricity, Gas and Other Fuels has 14.6124 and Transport has 9.6468.
questions.evidence: p.1: "These three divisions account for over 57 per cent of the weights"; p.2: "Food and Non-Alcoholic Beverages 32.9094"; p.2: "Housing, Water, Electricity, Gas and Other Fuels 14.6124"; p.2: "Transport 9.6468"

questions.question: Which sectors recorded negative growth in the second quarter of 2008, and by how much did each decline?
questions.answer: Hotels and Restaurants declined by 31.5 per cent, and Transport and Communication declined by 3.5 per cent.
questions.evidence: p.2: "Hotels and Restaurants, and Transport and Communication recorded negative growths"; p.4: "it recorded a decline of 31.5 per cent in the second quarter of 2008"; p.4: "The sector is estimated to have declined by 3.5 per cent in the second quarter of 2008"

questions.question: Did the five largest county economies grow faster or slower than the total economy in 2014 to 2019?
questions.answer: Slower. The top five counties grew at an average rate of 3.9 percent. The real gross value added of the total economy grew by 4.6 percent.
questions.evidence: p.17: "growth of overall real GVA, i.e. 4.6 percent"; p.17: "grew at an average rate of 3.9 percent"

questions.question: In January to March 2024, did tea earn more export revenue than cut flowers and coffee together?
questions.answer: Yes. Tea earned KSh 57.8 billion. Cut flowers earned KSh 31.2 billion and coffee KSh 7.6 billion, which is KSh 38.8 billion together.
questions.evidence: p.3: "KSh 57.8bn 25% Increase in revenue from export of tea"; p.3: "KSh 31.2bn"; p.3: "KSh 7.6 bn"

questions.question: The producer price of sugar fell by 20.4 per cent in the year to March 2018. Did the index of the manufacture of food products also fall in that year?
questions.answer: No. The index of the manufacture of food products rose by 0.72 per cent in the year to March 2018.
questions.evidence: p.2: "Manufacture of food products 34.24 1.18 0.72"; p.3: "a tonne of sugar declined by 20.4 per cent"

questions.question: Between April and May 2008, did the export values of coffee and tea change in the same direction?
questions.answer: No. The export value of coffee rose by 1.8 per cent to KSh 1,128.1 million. The export value of tea declined by 17.2 per cent to KSh 4,525.4 million.
questions.evidence: p.6: "its export value rose marginally by 1.8 per cent from KSh 1,107.7 million to KSh 1,128.1 million"; p.6: "its export value declined by 17.2 per cent from KSh 5,464.0 million to KSh 4,525.4 million"

questions.question: What was the food poverty rate of West Pokot County in 2019, and how did it change from 2015/16?
questions.answer: 51.1 per cent in 2019, a decrease of 6.2 percentage points from 57.3 per cent in 2015/16.

questions.question: Which sub-county of West Pokot County had the most hospital beds in 2014, and how many sub-locations does that sub-county have?
questions.answer: West Pokot sub-county, with 176 beds. It has 86 sub-locations.
questions.evidence: p.51: "West Pokot 176 4"; p.18: "West Pokot 4 28 86"

questions.question: Between the first and second quarters of 2021, which index rose more: the building cost index or the civil engineering cost index?
questions.answer: The civil engineering cost index. It rose by 1.63 per cent, from 106.21 to 107.94. The building cost index rose by 1.55 per cent, from 102.46 to 104.05.
questions.evidence: p.1: "building cost and civil engineering cost indices by 1.55 and 1.63 per cent respectively"; p.2: "Overall Building Cost Index 100 100 102.46 104.05"; p.3: "Overall Civil Engineering Cost Index 100.00 100 106.21 107.94"

questions.question: How did the base period of the Consumer Price Index change between the August 2007 release and the October 2023 release?
questions.answer: The August 2007 release uses the base period October 1997 = 100. The October 2023 release uses the base period February 2019 = 100.
questions.evidence: cpi-2007-08 p.2: "Base period: October 1997=100"; cpi-2023-10 p.1: "Base Feb 2019=100"

questions.question: Compare the overall inflation rates in the releases of August 2007, April 2011 and October 2023.
questions.answer: 12.4 per cent in August 2007, 12.05 per cent in April 2011 and 6.9 per cent in October 2023. The rate of October 2023 is the lowest of the three.
questions.evidence: cpi-2007-08 p.1: "from 13.6 per cent in July 2007 to 12.4 per cent in August 2007"; cpi-2011-04 p.1: "The overall inflation rate stood at 12.05 per cent in April 2011"; cpi-2023-10 p.1: "was 6.9 per cent, in October 2023"

questions.question: How did producer price inflation change between the first quarter of 2018 and the first quarter of 2019?
questions.answer: The year on year producer inflation fell from 1.53 per cent in March 2018 to negative 0.36 per cent in March 2019. In the year to March 2018, the highest increases were wood products (8.61 per cent) and chemicals (8.31 per cent). In the year to March 2019, wood products rose by 21.25 per cent, and food products and electricity declined by 5.02 and 2.78 per cent.
questions.evidence: ppi-2018-q1 p.1: "overall producer inflation was 1.53 per cent in March 2018"; ppi-2018-q1 p.1: "which rose by 8.61 per cent followed by manufacture of chemicals and chemical products which increased by 8.31 per cent"; ppi-2019-q1 p.1: "was negative 0.36 per cent in March 2019"; ppi-2019-q1 p.1: "increase was on manufacture of wood and of products of wood which rose by 21.25 per cent"; ppi-2019-q1 p.2: "declined by 5.02 per cent and 2.78 per cent"

questions.question: Which effects of the post-election violence on the economy in 2008 do the reports describe?
questions.answer: The Gross Domestic Product release of the second quarter of 2008 says that the slower growth of 3.2 per cent shows the spillover effects of the violence, and that Hotels and Restaurants and Transport and Communication declined again. The Leading Economic Indicators of May 2008 say that milk deliveries in the formal milk sector declined by 24.1 per cent in the first quarter of 2008 because of the violence, and that sugar production increased by 30.5 per cent in May 2008 when the effects decreased.
questions.evidence: gdp-2008-q2 p.2: "it is estimated to have expanded by 3.2 per cent"; gdp-2008-q2 p.2: "spillover effects in certain sectors of the post-election violence"; gdp-2008-q2 p.2: "indicating that the effects of the violence continued to be felt in the second quarter"; lei-2008-05 p.8: "declined significantly by 24.1 per cent from 108.1 million litres in the first quarter of 2007 to 82.0 million litres in the same quarter of 2008 due to the post election violence"; lei-2008-05 p.8: "Domestic production of sugar increased significantly by 30.5 per cent from 39,968 MT in April 2008 to 50,865 MT in May 2008 showing economic upturn after the dissipating of post elections effects"

questions.question: What do the reports say about the size of the economy and the level of poverty of West Pokot County?
questions.answer: The Gross County Product report gives West Pokot about 0.7 percent of the gross value added on average in 2013 to 2020. It names West Pokot as one of the small economies that grew much faster than the larger economies in 2014 to 2019. The poverty report of 2019 gives West Pokot a food poverty rate of 51.1 per cent, the fourth highest of the counties, and an overall poverty rate of 57.7 per cent.
questions.evidence: gcp-2021 p.22: "WEST POKOT 0.7 0.7 0.7 0.8 0.7 0.7 0.7 0.8 0.7"; gcp-2021 p.17: "Marsabit, Isiolo, Samburu, Mandera and West Pokot grew much faster"; poverty-2019 p.15: "Mandera (60%), Samburu (58.4%) and West Pokot (51.1%)"; poverty-2019 p.44: "West Pokot 57.7"; poverty-2019 p.55: "West Pokot 57.3 51.1 (6.2) 57.4 57.7 0.3"

questions.question: What do the reports say about tea production and tea exports in 2008 and in 2024?
questions.answer: In the second quarter of 2008, the output of tea decreased to 86,634 metric tonnes from 90,080. In May 2008, the quantity of processed tea increased to 36,402 MT, and tea exports declined by 25.1 per cent in quantity and by 17.2 per cent in value, to KSh 4,525.4 million. In January to March 2024, the revenue from the export of tea was KSh 57.8 billion, an increase of 25 per cent.
questions.evidence: gdp-2008-q2 p.3: "outputs of coffee and tea decreased to 9,553 and 86,634 metric tones from 18,766 and 90,080 metric tonnes"; lei-2008-05 p.6: "Quantity of processed tea increased by 32.8 per cent from 27,415 MT in April 2008 to 36,402 MT in May 2008"; lei-2008-05 p.6: "Quantity of tea exported declined significantly by 25.1 per cent"; lei-2008-05 p.6: "its export value declined by 17.2 per cent from KSh 5,464.0 million to KSh 4,525.4 million"; bop-2024-q1 p.3: "KSh 57.8bn 25% Increase in revenue from export of tea"

questions.question: What caused the rise of the transport index in the Consumer Price Index releases of April 2011 and October 2023?
questions.answer: In April 2011, the transport index rose by 4.29 per cent because the prices of petrol, diesel and bus/matatu fares went up by 8.47, 2.32 and 5.97 per cent. In October 2023, it increased by 1.5 per cent because the prices of petrol and diesel rose by 2.7 and 2.2 per cent.
questions.evidence: cpi-2011-04 p.2: "The Transport index rose by 4.29 per cent, mainly due to increased costs of petrol, diesel and bus/matatu fares"; cpi-2011-04 p.2: "The prices of these items went up by 8.47, 2.32 and 5.97 per cent"; cpi-2023-10 p.2: "The Transport Index increased by 1.5 per cent between September 2023 and October 2023"; cpi-2023-10 p.2: "a rise in prices of petrol and diesel by 2.7 per cent and 2.2 per cent"
